# Apple og Nvidia viser muskler - men lurer en korrektion?

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-09-10  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is a Danish episode of Euroinvestor's Millionærklubben, with Nordea chief strategist Josefine Setti and Joachim Brygman of Pluto Markets. They argue the market is driven by earnings and that the AI trade still has room to run: Nvidia and the big tech names trade at low multiples despite strong growth, and the AI trade is spreading into banks, industrials, engineering, biotech and small caps. The main risks they discuss are rising long US yields (the 30-year near 5.3%), oil above $100 and a possible recession.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NVDA — Nvidia | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Both guests say Nvidia is cheap: ~PE18 while growing ~100%, capacity-limited, and hedged via the Hugging Face and open-source push.

#### Reasoning

Guest views: Setti (Nordea) says Nvidia trades at ~PE18 though it could double revenue next year without capacity limits. Brygman says he has never seen profitable growth this cheap, with P/E at consumer-staples levels. The market prices in heavy normalisation that has not happened two years running. Hardware moats slow disruption, and the Hugging Face deal spreads its bets across whichever AI model wins.

#### Sell Triggers

- AI capex boom stalls or political opposition halts data center construction
- competition from custom chips (TPUs, OpenAI chip) erodes margins
- recession or AI bubble bursting
- rising long yields trigger a macro downturn

> *"Kig på Nvidia, den handler på sådan en PE18, på trods af, at de vil kunne doble deres omsætning i næste regnskabsår"*

---

### 🟢 CRM — Salesforce | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Growth recovered and the stock rose 17%. Guests say the SaaS sell-off went too far. A horizontal player with deep enterprise ties is well placed in AI.

#### Reasoning

Brygman says software fears were overdone: two quarters of normal growth, Salesforce back to top- and bottom-line growth, and analysts now see AI as an opportunity. Setti thinks broad horizontal players like Salesforce and Microsoft are strongly placed. She is more worried about vertical SaaS names.

#### Sell Triggers

- AI-driven revenue decline shows up in results
- Anthropic launches competing enterprise products

> *"her seneste kvartal, der er de tilbage til at vækste toplinjen, de vækster bundlinjen massivt, og aktien stiger 17 procent"*

---

### 🟢 MSFT — Microsoft | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Setti says the market wrongly prices big tech such as Microsoft and Alphabet. OpenAI's recovery helps Microsoft's ecosystem.

#### Reasoning

Setti argues hyperscalers trade below their 5-10 year valuations while the market doubts they can make users pay. If AI delivers even part of the hoped-for productivity gains, these stocks are mispriced. Microsoft is also a strong horizontal software player.

#### Sell Triggers

- failure to monetise AI
- AI capex not paying off

> *"så tror jeg, at markedet prissætter mange af de her store tech-aktier ret forkert"*

---

### 🟢 GOOGL — Alphabet | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Big-tech hyperscalers are seen as undervalued. Alphabet benefits from its Anthropic stake and its own TPUs.

#### Reasoning

Setti's broad view that hyperscalers trade at lower valuations than over the last 5-10 years despite AI upside. Alphabet's Anthropic stake gets mark-to-market gains, and it builds its own chips.

#### Sell Triggers

- failure to monetise AI
- Anthropic IPO disappoints

> *"så handler de altså på nogle lavere værdierindsættelser, end de har gjort over de sidste 5-10 år her"*

---

### 🟠 MU — Micron | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Setti notes memory stocks trade around PE 4-5 despite tight supply and rising prices, which she reads as excessive scepticism.

#### Reasoning

Memory prices are rising sharply and supply is tight (even Apple cannot secure enough). Setti notes low multiples but admits more competition is coming. Speculative value angle.

#### Sell Triggers

- new memory capacity (e.g. the Chinese producer) collapses prices
- AI demand slows

> *"de handler altså på sådan noget PE, 4-5 stykker eller et eller andet"*

---

### 🟡 AAPL — Apple | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

The foldable iPhone impressed, but Setti sees a high valuation with almost no growth, and memory supply problems. Without the AI boost the core business is value-like.

#### Reasoning

Brygman was positive on the iPhone Duo and the ecosystem lock-in, but calls the core business a value company once the AI tailwind (Mac Mini demand) is removed. Setti sees the price as high relative to growth and was disappointed by supply-chain management around memory costs. A new CEO may bring innovation. Mixed overall.

#### Sell Triggers

- foldable iPhone sells poorly
- memory costs squeeze margins
- no growth recovery under the new CEO

> *"Apple er jo et sted, hvor de er stadig priset til den høje side, vil jeg mene, i forhold til at de nærmest ikke har noget vækst længere"*

---

### 🟠 ORSTED — Ørsted | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Brygman says the announced ~DKK 3bn shareholder sale removes an overhang of selling pressure, usually a positive effect. Stock +0.6%.

#### Reasoning

Brygman's technical view: the announcement means the large sale is already done, so the persistent selling pressure is lifted. This is a short-term technical point, not a fundamental call.

#### Sell Triggers

- further large share sales
- fundamental offshore wind setbacks

> *"Så det har ofte den modsatte effekt, og vi ser altså, at Ørested stiger 0,6 procent i dag"*

---
